payload.text: The three one-command releases (vc decision 28): Cldr v0.2.1, its first signed one (cldr-dc's prep commit: version_from, lock-sync, doctor gate, CHANGELOG; then its signer proof; cldr-vc validates and dry-runs). ccusage v0.1.7 (ccusage-dc: post-cut over macos finalize and formula publish, notarised always with geodica.apple.*; ccusage-vc validates and dry-runs). pplr v2.0.1 after ST0003.
